Use case: precise-object-edit.
Recompose the supplied wide photographic molten-rock asset into a NEW TALL PORTRAIT production plate, 853 x 1844 pixels, approximately 9:19.5 aspect ratio. The final image MUST be portrait, not landscape. Do not rotate or simply crop the source. Use its exact tactile material family and lighting vocabulary to build an intentionally composed vertical image.
Subject: enormous heavy black molten rock in thick rope-like folded lobes, dense viscous ridges, a continuous narrow meandering orange internal heat path. Preserve the original's pitted cooling skin, restrained glassy grazing highlights, luminous inner fold, weight, and real volcanic photography. This is a close material sculpture, not a volcano, river, product card or landscape.
CRITICAL LAYOUT: the top 7 percent of the portrait is completely pure black. The entire LEFT 70 percent between 15 and 40 percent of image height is nearly pure black smooth NEGATIVE SPACE with no bright texture, no orange, no rock edge and no object. This precisely reserved area will hold two lines of large white type and one line of smaller type later. Do not render any text. Keep this upper-left void genuinely dark and visually simple.
Place the giant thick folds down the RIGHT EDGE and across the LOWER HALF. The rock begins as a narrow black shoulder at the far-right edge around 25-35 percent height, then swells massively into the frame below 45 percent height. The lower 50 percent should be occupied by large sculptural folds and dense tactile crust reaching and cropping beyond the left, right and bottom boundaries. A single narrow hot internal path descends through these lower folds, quietly winding right-to-center-to-right; the strongest tiny incandescent slit is below 55 percent height. Keep hot color under 7 percent of the whole picture, 80-90 percent of the image rich black/graphite, with subtle local black detail and no broad grey/white reflection sheets.
Lighting: contained inner fire, short-range red-orange light only inside fold creases. Minimal cool neutral raking light on the LOWER folds shows real heavy mineral material. The upper copy void must remain black. Museum-grade geological macro photography, extremely high detail, no stylized lava shader.
Absolutely no UI, writing, title, letters, numbers, arrows, border or watermark. No flames, smoke, particles, glowing web, fantasy rock, gaming VFX, orange background or waterlike fluid.
